category: finops (GPU/LLM spend-management SaaS; legacy managed GPU training platform 'ISC')

free_tier.stated: a free account in demo mode, plus a 3-month free trial of cost tracking that has to be applied for and granted; the product tracks spend on compute that is already bought

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: Access interface not documented in published terms.

limits.value: the trial has to be applied for and granted; the product tracks the user's existing GPU and token spend rather than supplying compute

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented. Off-category.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not stated in the source card. `email` is the assumed value because every priced host in the set requires an account, and no signup was performed, so the kind is not established for this provider

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the site was read on 2026-10-22 and states the free demo account and the granted 3-month trial. The product is a cost dashboard, so no compute is supplied and the verdict stays paid-only with a better reason

evidence.proved: listed in the peli-cloud corpus card at commit f6a71ab0; the card is the source, not the vendor page
